name: Starlink V1.5 public RF reference
description: Non-flight public-data reference for a Starlink V1.5-class spacecraft. Public regulatory values and explicit engineering assumptions are retained for GMAT, Simu-CIC, OPALIS and RF-COMLINK preparation.
limitations: This reference does not identify a specific NORAD object, spacecraft serial number, operational beam, gateway assignment, user-terminal generation, modulation/coding profile, or network scheduling state.
SpaceX does not publicly disclose exact Starlink V1.5 RF payload EIRP, antenna patterns, receiver G/T, TT&C waveform, coding, or operational bit rates needed to claim a flight-accurate link budget.

RF-COMLINK may be run only after a selected geometry CIC set and a selected Earth endpoint are supplied. Engineering-assumption results are proxy/sensitivity results, not measured Starlink performance.

data_status_values.public_confirmed: Directly stated in a public regulator or operator source.
data_status_values.public_site_specific: Public, but valid only for the named ground site, authorization and timeframe.
data_status_values.engineering_assumption: Needed to make a test model executable; not asserted to be a Starlink V1.5 value.
data_status_values.not_public: No defensible public numerical value located; do not silently replace with an assumption.
data_status_values.derived: Computed from other values; retain equation and inputs.

sources.title: FCC 21-48, SpaceX Gen1 Ku/Ka NGSO modification
SpaceX Hamshire, Texas gateway special temporary authority

mass_kg.note: Simulation proxy revised for mass consistency and a usable V1.5-class delta-V reserve. It is not a published SpaceX mass breakdown.

propulsion_subsystem.type: Krypton Hall-effect electric propulsion (V1.5-class simulation proxy)
propulsion_subsystem.operational_rule: Use nominal thrust and duty cycle for long orbit-raising/station-keeping scenarios. Use maximum thrust only for explicitly scheduled manoeuvre arcs; never model maximum thrust continuously unless that scenario is intentional.

derived_performance.note: Derived values assume one effective spacecraft thrust vector and use the wet mass.

electric_thruster.note: The former 2500 s / 4.2 kW model is not used as a V1.5 nominal operating point. A 4.2 kW point may be used only together with the explicit maximum-thrust manoeuvre setting.

electric_propulsion_mode.note: Payload-reduced orbit-raising allocation. With 4.2 kW generation and 20% system margin it leaves 1.12 kW nominally available to the thruster, close to the 1.0 kW nominal operating point.

electrical_subsystem.note: The nominal 3.5 kW load is retained for spacecraft-level accounting. GMAT electric-transfer uses the explicit electric-propulsion mission-mode allocation when present.

default_model_shell.note: Default only. Replace with the shell and state vector for the selected Starlink object before generating Simu-CIC files.

TT_and_C.mission_function: telemetry, tracking and command during de-orbit; payload testing and LEOP authority is publicly described
TT_and_C.rfcomlink_rule: Do not create a flight-labelled TT&C budget. A proxy TT&C link requires an explicitly approved engineering assumption set.

satellite_rf_parameters_not_public: per-beam spacecraft EIRP and EIRP density
spacecraft receiver G/T and noise temperature
spacecraft antenna gain patterns and beam steering loss
active beam count and frequency reuse state
modulation, coding, frame structure and allocation per beam

gateway_baxley_ga_proxy.purpose: Public, site-specific feeder-link reference. It is suitable as a starting RF-COMLINK ground-station profile for a Ka gateway calculation, not as a universal Starlink gateway.

transmit.allowed_modulation_envelope: BPSK up to 64 QAM; digital data

receive.rfcomlink_rule: A numerical G/T is required for a full downlink budget. Do not derive it from gain alone without a documented receiver noise-temperature assumption.

starlink_user_terminal_generic.purpose: Endpoint category only; terminal hardware varies by generation and service. Select a terminal FCC authorization or a measured terminal profile before calculating a user-link margin.
missing_for_RF_COMLINK: receive G/T or receiver noise temperature
selected channel centre frequency and bandwidth

from_Simu_CIC: satellite_direction_file when a spacecraft antenna pattern is used
ground_station_direction_file when a ground antenna pattern is used
elevation_file or a geometry source sufficient for atmospheric modelling
from_scenario_or_network_planner: selected Starlink shell and actual satellite state
selected service link and channel centre frequency
bandwidth, modulation, coding, data rate and required BER

gateway_uplink_public_profile.frequency_selection_status: engineering_assumption; centre of an authorized 28.6-29.1 GHz sub-band
gateway_uplink_public_profile.blocking_missing_input: Spacecraft receiver G/T is not public; do not report a completed margin without an approved assumption.

gateway_downlink_public_profile.frequency_selection_status: engineering_assumption; centre of an authorized 17.8-18.6 GHz sub-band

user_link_proxy_profile.use_case: sensitivity study, not Starlink performance reproduction

allowed_automatic_actions: Read public values with source URL and access date.
Select values only when they match the named endpoint, authorization and direction.
Generate a Simu-CIC geometry request from a selected shell, state vector and site.
Calculate derived quantities while retaining formulas and source inputs.
human_approval_required: Any engineering_assumption inserted into an RF-COMLINK execution profile.
Any choice of modulation, coding, BER, data rate, spacecraft EIRP, antenna pattern, G/T or noise temperature that is not explicitly public for the selected configuration.
Any claim that a result represents actual Starlink performance.
prohibited_automatic_actions: Inventing a proprietary Starlink V1.5 TT&C parameter.
Treating a regulatory maximum as an operational setpoint.
Reusing site-specific gateway values for another Starlink gateway without marking the change as an assumption.
